changes.reason: Retain the explicit thousand in the sensory image rather than flattening it to an unquantified multitude.
Fairly sure is the players degree of belief, not the absolute certainty implied by 틀림없이.

preserved: Kzer-Za slavery/imprisonment and Kohr-Ah extermination remain distinct. Genocidal punishment threats by Kzer-Za are nevertheless preserved where the source states them.
The denial that Ur-Quan lie and the claimed benefits of slavery remain character claims, without editorial endorsement or contradiction.
Compulsion discovery interrupts authority with fear and urgency; the conditional pardon requires immediate return to Earth and destruction of the ship.
Defeated Kzer-Za warn the human to flee while remaining to guard Sa-Matra for the victors; the next migration and doctrinal war are retained.
Surrender spares some crew but not the captain/officers; the final plea does not promise the captains survival.
Six Milieu races, thousands of enslaved years, 20,000 years, thousands dominated/hundreds saved and thousand-death comparison retain their scope.
Path of Now and Forever is retained as the Kzer-Za title even though the Kohr-Ah text also uses it; the glossary explicitly records this source inconsistency.
OUT_TAKES speaker is the small translator in the corner, not the Ur-Quan; its cute language and musical joke remain separate.
Source record order, line boundaries and shared key phrase remain unchanged.
limitations: Agent semantic review is not user approval.
Static record comparison does not prove hypnotic wake-up, surrender, homeworld or post-war branches execute correctly. Runtime subtitle/audio synchronization and font readability remain pending.
